Sources & limitations

Statistical blocks: Canton Basel-Stadt, open government data (CC BY 4.0); joined with Basler Atlas indicators. Basemaps: © OpenStreetMap contributors, OpenFreeMap (vector); © swisstopo (topographic), subject to fair use. Vector styling is a selective representation of urban space. Indicators: Basler Atlas, population statistics and official land-cover survey. Foreign population means non-Swiss nationality, not migration status. Fieldwork: 13 November 2026; preliminary, non-systematic observations. Absence of graffiti refers only to observed surfaces. No citywide inference is supported.
